title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 5646 rto (AKU HT 58787)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja Stern, Tabitha Kraus, Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 58787

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 58787; AKU grapheme A0670 (AKU GR 7). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: A4 (var), A30 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 2, 38, 39, 59, v3p4n3. Occurrence: line 5; find place Theben; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 17.2 x 10.9 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja Stern, Tabitha Kraus, Ursula Verhoeven. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
